top_signal.title: If you generate leads for your business, stay away from this scam!
top_signal.summary: I run a small corporate video production company, and a major part of my business involves reaching out to manufacturing businesses that might need corporate films.   For that, I regularly look for ways to generate relevant B2B leads. Recently, I decided to try Apollo to find potential clients, but I needed a tool that could scrape leads from Apollo without having to pay for its expensive subscription plans.   While searching for options, I came across several YouTube videos recommending Apify. A lot of people seemed to be using it for Apollo lead scraping, so naturally, I decided to give it a try.   But honestly, I found Apify way too complicated. I watched multiple tutorials, tried understanding how everything worked, but the whole process felt unnecessarily technical. I am not a developer, so I just wanted a simple tool that could get me business leads.   Then I came across another YouTube video where someone recommended Ample Leads. The video mentioned that a developer who created one of the most popular Apollo lead scraping tools on Apify had also developed Ample Leads. I visited their website, checked out the interface, and it actually looked pretty simple. No complicated setup, no confusing workflows. Just select what you need and start scraping. So I thought, why not give it a try?   So I went ahead and purchased a subscription for approximately 25,000 leads.
